name: INARI
recent: Inari Amertron 在2026年11月18日公布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩，营收环比增长27.5%至3.685亿令吉，净利环比大增892.6%至6100万令吉。公司宣布每股1.00仙免税中期股息及0.50仙单层股息，除息日为12月9日。同期，雇员公积金局（EPF）和退休基金局（KWAP）多次申报股权变动，公司也因雇员认购ESOS期权而多次发行新股。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日季度业绩，营收3.685亿令吉，净利6100万令吉。
宣布每股1.00仙免税中期股息及0.50仙单层股息，除息日12月9日，派发日2027年1月8日。
因雇员行使ESOS期权，于11月13日及11月27日多次发行新股上市。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在11月多日申报股权变动。
退休基金局（KWAP）在11月多日申报股权变动。
董事局出现变动，MR HO PHON GUAN 于11月19日卸任。
earnings: 截至2026年9月30日季度，营收3.685亿令吉，环比增长27.5%，同比增长13.1%；净利6100万令吉，环比增长892.6%，同比增长18.5%；净利率16.6%，上一季度为2.1%。

recent_en: Inari Amertron announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 18 November 2026, with revenue up 27.5% QoQ to RM368.5 million and net profit up 892.6% QoQ to RM61.0 million. The company declared a first interim tax-exempt dividend of 1.00 sen and a single-tier dividend of 0.50 sen per share, with ex-date on 9 December. Meanwhile, EPF and KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder notices, and the company issued new shares from ESOS option exercises.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM368.5 million and net profit of RM61.0 million.
Declared a first interim tax-exempt dividend of 1.00 sen and a single-tier dividend of 0.50 sen per share, ex-date 9 December, payment date 8 January 2027.
Listed new shares on 13 November and 27 November following ESOS option exercises by employees.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder change notices in November.
KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder change notices in November.
Boardroom change: Mr Ho Phon Guan ceased to be a director on 19 November.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM368.5 million, up 27.5% QoQ and 13.1% YoY; net profit was RM61.0 million, up 892.6% QoQ and 18.5% YoY; net margin was 16.6% versus 2.1% in the previous quarter.
